name: Numenta Anomaly Benchmark (NAB)
description: A collection of real-world and artificial time series designed to evaluate algorithms for streaming anomaly detection, with labeled anomalies and a scoring methodology that accounts for timely detection.
citation: Lavin, A., & Ahmad, S. (2015). Evaluating Real-Time Anomaly Detection Algorithms — The Numenta Anomaly Benchmark. 2015 IEEE 14th International Conference on Machine Learning and Applications (ICMLA), 38–44. https://doi.org/10.1109/ICMLA.2015.141
